survey: A green hiking backpack shown three-quarter from the front-left. A blue rolled sleeping mat lies across the top. Two brown straps wrap around the mat and run down behind the top flap into the top of the bag. The spiral end of the mat faces right and shows a proper roll. The rounded top flap closes with two brown straps, each with a metal buckle, and the strap tips hang below the buckles. Under the flap is a front pocket with its own lighter-green flap and a second pair of buckled straps. Each side has a gusseted pocket with a flap. One padded shoulder strap shows behind the right edge and curves down to the base. The bag sits flat on the floor with a contact shadow. Every strap starts and ends at the bag or loops around the mat. The parts appear in matching pairs, and nothing floats or passes through anything else. This is a simplified version of a real backpack that would work.
